deviations: Field of study entered as the 4-category subject_cat (Others/Law/Economics/Sciences) rather than the 14-value q_subject.

High-school GPA and last math grade entered as the dataset's categorical versions (q_abitur_grade_cat, quartiles with category 5 = missing/no A-level; q_math_grade_cat quartiles) so no observations are dropped for the 400 rows with missing GPA.
Perceived multitasking ability entered as the Likert item perc_multitasking_1 only (not perc_multitasking_2).
Online controls: age, gender factor (female/male/other), and screen size as window_height1 and window_width1 (linear).
Clustered SEs use fixest's default small-sample correction; coefficients are unaffected.
notes: Attempt-1 was an exploratory variable listing (no RESULT lines). Lab sample: formatted_data_replication.dta restricted to Treatment_Incentives != Ample (payoff schemes 10/20/40, both waves via original_lab), giving 12160 subject-rounds and 608 subjects in Baseline, Directed Attention and Forced Choice. Outcomes: summation_correct (decision task correct), default_followed (default adherence; in Forced Choice the dataset codes choice of the default-equivalent alternative), load_correct (background task correct), payoff_share (share of maximal payoff). Regressors: Treatment_intervention, or Directed/Forced indicators for column 7. Controls (cols 2, 6, T3 col 2): q_age, q_gender, subject_cat, q_abitur_grade_cat, q_math_grade_cat, ability_load, ability_task, perc_multitasking_1, payoff-scheme and wave dummies. Online: formatted_data_long_mturk.dta, memory (0-1 points in Memory task, read as fraction of pairs uncovered) on Treatment_intervention, 5472 subject-rounds, 608 subjects. All OLS via fixest with SEs clustered by subject_id.
